comment: Normative lane table for B2 metadata_only (agreed design, Codex ruling 2026-08-28). Both the C# and TypeScript classifiers MUST pass every case; parity is proven by this one file. Lanes: text, identity, metadata, unclassified_render. Unknown or empty reasons render normally and are never suppressed, but the code must not assert identity it has not classified.

cases.note: Codex B2 review O3: the work vector is built from subjects (hierarchy, domains, act form, roles) plus names, never provision text, so semantic_work mixes subject metadata with identity evidence and cannot positively certify any lane; it renders, is never suppressed, and disables the metadata_only claim when present

unreachable today: FindSemantic selects evidence_kind='work' only. If it becomes reachable its lane must follow the bound evidence kind, which the wire does not carry, so it stays unclassified_render until the producer emits that trace (Codex B2 review O3)
an article-number provision hit is text evidence, found by the same sweep
fuzzy-expansion keyword retrieval, found by the same sweep
an exact publisher-recorded short title mention is a NAME (Codex Q2 ruling)
ambiguity wraps a resolution reason; resolution is identity work
ambiguity arises only during identity resolution; render, never suppress
token-OR FTS over identifiers aliases titles facets: the producer's own weak lane
a PARTIAL token overlap with a short title rides the weak lane the producer assigned; only the exact mention is identity
mixed: any text reason wins, nothing is suppressed
mixed: any identity reason wins over metadata
Codex Q1 ruling: renders through the existing visible path, never suppressed, and never asserted as identity
an unknown reason beside metadata forbids the metadata_only claim for this hit
